title: AI Containment
guidingQuestion: How do we keep AI helpful without letting agents overreach?
summary: Interface-level containment and consent so AI agents cannot manipulate, act, or expand scope without visible constraints.
webProblem: AI can influence without visible constraints

hero.headline: Powerful agents need visible fences.
hero.text: As AI agents browse, message, and act, people need clear containment: what an agent may do, what it may see, and how to stop it.

problemStory.title: Why this matters
problemStory.scenario: An assistant books, posts, and negotiates on your behalf after a vague prompt. You discover the trail only after something goes wrong, with no clear undo.

webLimitations.title: Why today's Web struggles
webLimitations.text: Interfaces were built for humans clicking. Agent permissions are bolted on, often all-or-nothing, without shared containment primitives across sites.

futureVision.title: Imagine instead
futureVision.text: Every AI action runs inside declared bounds: purpose, data access, duration, and community rules, with consent you can revoke.

audiences.label: Everyday users
audiences.why: Use agents without fear of silent overreach.

audiences.label: Parents
audiences.why: Contain AI around children with clear limits.

exampleDomains.label: Customer support
exampleDomains.text: Contained bots with escalation to humans.
